method: Manual review under writing-naturalness.md, checked against live GitHub PR metadata and job records, bounded read-only worktree inventories, the fresh R focused-test output, and the local branch state; followed by exact-draft assessment-check, slop_check.py, and check-after-task.R.
coverage: Whole report, sections 1 through 12, including the live PR and CI refreshes and R and Julia worktree inventories through 2026-11-02 10:00 UTC.
score_reason: The report uses exact files, SHAs, run IDs, and explicit limits. Some technical sentences are dense, but the PR status is separated into short bullets.
confidence_reason: PR heads, review states, workflow jobs, the focused local R test, and bounded worktree counts were checked against live connector records and local command output. The R scan covered open-PR branches; the Julia scan covered registered worktrees but included unreadable entries. Julia shard 2 remained in progress at 10:00 UTC. The style judgment is a self-review and is not calibrated.
